routes.input_ownership: run-control authentication from headers; no body/path input
rules: response run/data identity exactly matches the authenticated run-control context

routes.input_ownership: run_id,data_instance_id,command_id from strict JSON body; run-control authentication from headers
rules: same committed shutdown command is idempotent
new mutations are rejected once quiescence begins

routes.input_ownership: browser session/Host only; no body/path input
live-host target is the current canonical data instance; no arbitrary filesystem path accepted over HTTP
rules: offline CLI/status adapter is a separate race-safe lock + immutable read-only path and is never exposed as an arbitrary-path HTTP API

global_transport_rules: Only exact 127.0.0.1 origin selected by the current run is supported in Beta 1.0; no wildcard/LAN binding.
LLD-12 validates exact Host and the referenced browser/run-control policy before handlers execute.
Unknown JSON fields are rejected by the named DTO contract; route byte limits are enforced before parsing.
Transport validation produces value objects; Starlette Request/Response objects do not cross into application/repository services.
All errors use errors.json stable categories; raw framework/database/OS exceptions are sanitized internally.
No Foundation route exposes arbitrary SQL, arbitrary filesystem mutation, migration repair, audit deletion/update, job-state forcing, database key material or reusable run/session credentials.
Domain routes reuse LLD-01 UoW/error/runtime conventions but remain owned by their packet.
